title: Tesla's Missing Autopilot Data Showed It Detected A Hazard Before Fatal Crash, Despite Claims It Was Missing

reading.body:
Tesla's Autopilot system was involved in a fatal crash. Tesla told the family that crash data had been deleted and was unavailable. A security researcher later demonstrated that the data had been retained on the vehicle all along, contradicting Tesla's account to the grieving family.

This is a failure of data stewardship in a deployed autonomous system. The crash data existed but was either not properly searched for or deliberately misrepresented. A jury found Tesla liable and ordered it to pay damages. It is not established from the available reports whether the data loss was claimed in good faith based on a genuine misunderstanding of the system's capabilities, or what specific safeguards might have prevented the initial false claim to the family.
